description: This file is a build configuration script for cross-compiling Rust libraries and compiler components for a specific target architecture within an embedded Linux build system. It defines package dependencies, build and install procedures, and environment setup for the cross-compiler toolchain.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds the Rust stage 2 compiler using the rust_runx build command.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs Rust libraries, binaries, and source files into the target filesystem, sets up environment variables, and adjusts library paths.
